lead: Eight states sue OpenAI over safeguards, an OpenAI employee is charged over a hidden recorder, and Anthropic is reported at $16.8B quarterly revenue.

sections.title: Eight states sue OpenAI, and an insider case
sections.intro: Eight attorneys general file separate suits over user safeguards, while an OpenAI employee is charged over a hidden recorder and ICE seeks AI call monitoring.

sections.title: Money and hardware: Anthropic revenue, Apple, Nvidia
sections.intro: Anthropic reportedly reaches $16.8B in Q3 revenue, Apple passes $5T, an RTX 5090 supply halt is rumored, and Bank of America details its AI patching bill.

sections.title: Agents in practice: loops, bots and autonomy limits
sections.intro: Builders share how they run agent teams and where controls belong, and an ex-Meta engineer challenges credit for Anthropic's Scion.

sections.title: Chip selloff, TSMC record and agent commerce
sections.intro: Chip stocks slide on rate and AI-funding fears even as TSMC posts record results, while Hinton, Meta AI in Brazil and agent payments draw attention.
